3mx

OOO «Trimiks» · ООО «Тримикс»

3mx is the trade name of OOO «Trimiks»RussianООО «Тримикс», registered in St Petersburg on 21.07.20231. It trades under the trademark «3mx», no. 11259672. Its owners and director have been hidden in the company register since 01.11.20241. It is under sanctions in Switzerland, EU, US, Japan and Ukraine3,4,5,6,7,8,9. Revenue in 2023: ₽45.6m10.

Reported by others

Translation“Yesterday the museum held a ceremony handing over an electronic-warfare device developed by OOO «TRIMIKS», the «Bulat» v. 4 detector, and the «Tair» individual alert device. The director general of OOO «TRIMIKS», A.F. Shagiakhmetov, spoke about the importance of the device for current counter-drone tactics. A cooperation agreement between the Mikhailovsky Military Artillery Academy and OOO «TRIMIKS» was also signed. Cadets of the academy were given certificates of honour.”RussianВчера в музее состоялась торжественная церемония передачи разработанного ООО «ТРИМИКС» средства радиоэлектронной борьбы – обнаружителя «Булат» v. 4 и устройства индивидуального оповещения «Таир». Генеральный директор ООО «ТРИМИКС» А.Ф. Шагиахметов рассказал о значимости данного изделия для современной тактики противодействия БПЛА. Кроме того, состоялось подписание соглашения о сотрудничестве между Михайловской военной артиллерийской академией и ООО «ТРИМИКС». Курсантам академии были вручены почетные грамоты.The Military Historical Museum of Artillery, Engineers and Signal Corps in St Petersburg, on its Telegram channel, 17.12.202536

What this page does not show

  • The owners, directors and original name before the register was closed come from an investigator's dossier. They are graded Reported until a register extract from before that date confirms them.
  • Some phone numbers and e-mails come from the investigation's own notes and are not yet tied to a published source.
  • No listing date is recorded for Switzerland; those listings are not on the timeline.
  • No document records the company as a formal member of a TsBST programme. Its link to TsBST rests on the posts and statements cited here.
  • No foreign components in its products are documented.
  • No use of its products in the field is documented. Handovers to military units are reported by donors and do not show use.

Facts here come from documents: the company register, its filed accounts, the patent and trademark registers, sanctions lists and its own posts. Entries resting on anything weaker are marked Reported and named above.
